name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      DATABASE_URL: sqlite:///./test.db
      SECRET_KEY: clave-solo-para-tests
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Instalar dependencias
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt pytest pytest-cov ruff httpx

      - name: Lint (calidad de codigo)
        run: ruff check .

      - name: Build (verificar que todo el codigo compila)
        run: python -m compileall -q .

      - name: Pruebas automaticas
        run: >
          pytest --cov=. --cov-report=xml --cov-fail-under=50
          --junitxml=reporte-tests.xml

      - name: Guardar reportes como artefactos
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: reportes-ci
          path: |
            coverage.xml
            reporte-tests.xml
